project: Stops every free-tier Supabase project pausing
notes: One Cloudflare Worker that reads every free-tier Supabase project on a six-hourly cron, backed by a daily GitHub Actions workflow in each site's own repo. Two schedulers on purpose, so neither failing alone can pause a database. Built after R4TW's database paused on 2026-08-15.
name: Supabase Keep-Alive
